sources.title: Daredevil Proximity
markers: | summary = '''Daredevil Proximity''' is a toggleable passive feature that allows the user to make ranged spell attack rolls without [[disadvantage]] even when adjacent to an enemy.

summary: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls. Daredevil Proximity changes ranged spell attacks into melee spell attacks when adjacent to a hostile creature.

fields.Daredevil Proximity: Toggle this passive off if you want to retain ranged spell attacks.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
